title: WoundAmbit: Bridging State-of-the-Art Semantic Segmentation and Real-World Wound Care
abstract: arXiv:2504.06185v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chronic wounds affect a large population, particularly the elderly and diabetic patients, who often exhibit limited mobility and co-existing health conditions. Automated wound monitoring via mobile image capture can reduce in-person physician visits by enabling remote tracking of wound size. Semantic segmentation is key to this process, yet wound segmentation remains underrepresented in medical imaging research. To address this, we benchmark state-of-the-art deep learning models from general-purpose vision, medical imaging, and top methods from public wound challenges. translated_title: WoundAmbit：连接最先进语义分割技术与真实世界伤口护理
translated_abstract: 慢性伤口影响着大量人群，尤其是老年人和糖尿病患者，他们通常行动受限并伴有其他健康问题。通过移动设备图像采集实现自动化伤口监测，可以支持远程跟踪伤口大小，从而减少患者面对面的就医次数。语义分割是实现这一过程的关键，然而伤口分割在医学影像研究中仍受到的关注不足。为此，我们对来自通用视觉领域、医学影像领域的最先进深度学习模型，以及公开伤口挑战赛中的顶级方法进行了基准测试。为了实现公平比较，我们统一了训练、数据增强和评估流程，并进行交叉验证以最小化数据划分偏差。我们还评估了实际部署相关的方面，包括在分布外伤口数据集上的泛化能力、计算效率以及可解释性。此外，我们提出了一种基于参考物体的伤口大小测量方法。
tldr: 该论文通过统一训练与评估流程，对通用视觉、医学影像及伤口挑战赛中的最先进分割模型进行了系统基准测试，评估了其在真实部署中的泛化性、效率与可解释性，并提出基于参考物体的伤口大小测量方法，以弥合前沿语义分割与实际伤口护理应用之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks state-of-the-art semantic segmentation models for wound segmentation under standardized training and evaluation, assesses real-world deployment factors including out-of-distribution generalization, computational efficiency, and interpretability, and proposes a reference object-based approach for wound size measurement, bridging cutting-edge segmentation research and practical wound care.
